findings.summary: BackendId and BackendKeyId are closed enums in sc-agent-types; a new provider/local model requires editing types, sc-jev-check, sc-ai and sc-jev-py. Docs claim the registry is open; only the Arc<dyn JudgeBackend> half is.
findings.evidence: sc-agent-types/src/ids.rs:109-151; sc-jev-check/src/registry/mod.rs:104-157 exhaustive backend_key_id/construct_backend; session/mod.rs:437 is_llm matches Haiku|Luna; run/exact.rs:84, registry/scripted.rs:41 repeat it; sc-ai/src/command.rs:119,626,687-691; sc-jev-py/src/run.rs:135-144 second hand-written string->BackendId table; judge.rs:117 and registry/mod.rs:4 claim 'future local judge needs no change'.
options: Open validated newtype BackendId(Cow<'static,str>) with constants; JudgeBackend gains requires_llm_prompt()/key_id(); BackendRegistry owns (id, factory) list; single BackendId::parse in sc-agent-types
Keep closed enum for Phase A: #[non_exhaustive] + docs stating 'adding a backend is a coordinated types change'
findings.note: Do before first external backend; serde shape change afterwards is breaking.

findings.summary: Second consumer (MCP/Node) must copy run orchestration and output shaping from sc-ai/sc-jev-py; engine stops at run_check/run_request; the two consumers already disagree.
findings.evidence: sc-ai/src/envelope.rs defines {version,operation,data} in CLI crate; sc-agent-types/src/envelope.rs:3-4 'Success envelopes stay in sc-ai'; hand-built serde_json maps command.rs:547-613; sc-jev-py different shape; repo root git toplevel (command.rs:700-738) vs cwd (run.rs:154-164); log/session defaults .sc-ai/ vs ~/.sc-agent/log + SC_AGENT_LOG_DIR; py accepts anthropic-haiku, sc-ai does not; PreparedRun split and dry-run plan built in sc-ai command.rs:404-502; merge_jev_response 625-646 branches on backend id.
options: Thin app-service layer (in sc-jev-check or new sc-jev-app crate): JevRunInput -> JevRunReport owning repo resolution, path defaults, Request/Check split; envelope + report serializer in sc-agent-types or that layer; sc-ai parses argv and prints; py/MCP/Node call same fn
Defer and accept a third copy at the first new consumer

findings.summary: Test-only knob changes public Python signature: run_check defined twice, scripted_answers only under test-util; ExecuteOverrides (registry, clock, session_ttl, session_log) always public in sc-ai.
findings.remediation: One run_check signature; scripted injection via separate _testing module registered only under test-util; ExecuteOverrides clock/session_ttl behind cfg or an 'embedding' struct.

findings.summary: Producer decoupling is correct (sc/subjects/1 via command/subjects kind; engine does not link tree-sitter) but undocumented as THE extension point; Extractor trait sealed over a closed 4-kind enum adds no extension and should be dropped.
findings.remediation: Document command/subjects as supported producer route; keep producer.language/mode free-form; drop Extractor trait (dyn dispatch over closed enum).

findings.summary: Two parallel HTTP transport traits and two retry loops (sc-jev JevTransport/RetryDelay vs sc-jev-backends BackendTransport/RetrySleeper); registry constructs HttpsTransport for Jev and UreqTransport for LLMs.
options: One HttpTransport trait + one retry policy in a shared small crate used by both
Share only the retry policy if Jev wire is genuinely different

findings.summary: SessionStore trait declared open but RunOptions, ask, and consumers take concrete FileSessionStore; trait lacks open/load/record_outcome; store couples to backend registry via Arc<RwLock<BackendRegistry>>.
findings.evidence: session/mod.rs:44-61 vs run/mod.rs:44,270,285-289; sc-ai command.rs:13,394; sc-jev-py run.rs:16,76
options: Make trait real: RunOptions.sessions: Arc<dyn SessionStore>, add open/load/record_outcome, pass registry to ask (unblocks SQLite/Postgres later)
Delete trait; state sessions are file-based in Phase A

findings.summary: JevError closed enum shared by all consumers; fix_hint free text; no retryable flag or details object; session_id baked into text.
findings.remediation: #[non_exhaustive] on JevError and ScAgentErrorResponse; retryable() in code table; optional details object; pin current set in error inventory doc. Before envelope frozen for MCP.

findings.summary: Haiku and Luna wrapper types are byte-for-byte parallel forwarding shells over one private Client.
findings.remediation: One LlmBackend (or generic over Provider descriptor) with Provider::haiku()/luna(); aliases for the two names.

findings.summary: resolve_key called inside engine when registry is None; no-secrets embedder (MCP with host credentials) has no clean key path.
findings.remediation: Document registry injection as official embedding path; key_resolver hook. After EXT-001.

findings.summary: Hand-rolled argv parser with two parallel flag tables + reject_* + help text kept in sync by hand.
findings.remediation: Table-driven parser or clap derive (~150 lines saved). Optional until MCP/Node force a shared schema.

findings.summary: JudgeOutcome.answers/probabilities/provider_meta untyped Value; sc-ai merges meta with provider-specific knowledge.

answers.new_producer_without_touching_engine_or_: YES via command/subjects + sc/subjects/1 (cleanest boundary in repo)

answers.over_abstraction: Extractor sealed/no use; SessionStore bypassed; two transport/retry stacks
answers.test_only_flags: scripted_answers on py run_check; ExecuteOverrides clock/session_ttl
answers.scaffolding_discipline: mostly good; ceremony localized to Haiku/Luna shells, dual-parser CLI, unused store trait

ResolvedApiKey held in backend not passed through trait
build_request single payload assembly entry used by all consumers
no hidden framework, no macro DSL, no server deps in CLI graph
